title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Priya Shah
body: Summary: Tighten RBAC v2 enforcement around KMS key region pinning and expand audit logging for KMS-related operations. Motivation: Customers in regulated regions require strong guarantees that keys and crypto operations are pinned to allowed regions and that all KMS usage is auditable with explicit key/region context. This change implements enforcement checks in the control plane for create/update requests that reference KMS keys, adds preflight validation in the private installer and API gateway, and hardens audit logs to include key_id, key_region, operation_context, and actor_role. It also includes a migration/backfill script and a small compatibility shim for older RBAC v2 policies. What changed: 1) Control plane validator: enforce kms_region matches tenant/residency policy; reject requests with mismatched regions unless explicit allow-list via admin policy. 2) Audit logging: add structured fields (key_id, key_region, key_alias, operation_context, resolved_tenant_region) and ensure logs emitted for create/update/decrypt/encrypt operations. 3) Private installer: fail-fast when on-prem config lacks required region tags; add flag --allow-legacy-keys for controlled upgrades. 4) Migration tool: backfill missing key region tags and emit dry-run mode. 5) Tests: unit tests for validator, end-to-end tests against a mocked KMS, and integration test for backfill. 6) Docs: update RBAC v2 policy reference and migration guide. Rollout plan: feature gated behind feature flag "rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce" for 2 weeks, start in canary, monitor audit logs and error rate, then flip for all tenants. Related: ENG-4678, SEC-129, COM-88. Breaking change: request validation will block mismatched KMS region requests when flag is enabled; migration guide provided.

d4e6b7c: tools: migration script kms_backfill.py with dry-run and reporting
e5f7c8d: tests: unit + e2e for kms region enforcement and audit changes

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Please add a unit test that covers the edge case where KMS key ARN contains a legacy partition and tenant residency is unset. Also please log the resolved tenant region in the control-plane error path.
Priya Shah: Added test for legacy partition case and adjusted error logs to include resolved_tenant_region. See commit c3d7a6b and tests updated in kms_region_validator_test.go.
Maya Patel: Can we have the migration tool default to dry-run and require explicit --apply flag? Also request logging on the backfill to include before/after key tags for auditability.

Priya Shah: Migration tool defaults to dry-run; --apply is required to run destructive changes. Backfill now emits a CSV report with before/after values and writes an audit-entry for each modified key. See kms_backfill.py commit.
Noah Kim: CI flagged a lint failure in the audit emitter (PEP8). After fix the CI run shows one flaky integration test failing intermittently; added retry and increased timeout in integration.yml.
Priya Shah: Fixed lint and added retry logic. Verified e2e passes locally and in CI rerun. Marking security review complete pending release notes.
Liam O'Connor: Approved for merge after feature flag and rollout plan documented. Requested post-merge monitoring alerts for audit-event drop rate.
Priya Shah: Added alert rule to slo-toolkit/alerts for audit-event drop rate and created a dashboard panel in observability-pack to track KMS audit event counts by region.
ci_checks: ci/unit: failed on first run (lint + style) - fixed
ci/integration: failed intermittently (flaky test) - increased timeout and retry
ci/deploy-canary: passed in canary region us-west-2
release_notes: Hardened RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS region pinning and expanded KMS audit logging. Requests that reference KMS keys now validate key region against tenant residency when the feature flag rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce is enabled. Migration tooling and docs provided to backfill missing key region tags. Customers should follow migration guide before enabling the flag.
